description: List the API operations a provider exposes, live from Alter's provider-spec catalog (e.g. "what can I call on google?"). Returns operation ids + methods/paths, plus the spec's source and freshness. Omit `kind` to auto-detect the provider family; when the id exists in both oauth and managed you'll be asked to pass `kind`. Machine-readable rows ride in `structuredContent` (see this tool's outputSchema) — read those rather than parsing the prose.

limit.description: Max operations to return (backend default 100, max 500).

offset.description: Zero-based offset for paging through large operation lists.

name: list_operations

offset.description: Zero-based offset of the first row.

operations.description: This page of operations, in the catalog's serving order.

operation_id.description: Pass to get_operation_schema for the full contract.

policy_operation_id.description: The exact name a policy rule uses for it: operation_id itself when reviewed, the provider-qualified <provider_id>:<operation_id> (for example zoom:deleteRole) when unreviewed — never the bare id, which other providers share and which never admits it (a save refuses it unless a reviewed operation has that id, when the save succeeds with a warning, or a custom integration the rule can reach maps it, when the save succeeds with no warning) — or null when no rule can name it.

policy_review.description: How a policy rule can name it: "reviewed" (Alter's reviewed catalog, with reviewed families), "unreviewed" (Alter has not reviewed it: every operation, family or content rule refuses it with operation_unreviewed unless an operation_allowlist entry or a require_approval rule whose every condition names it by policy_operation_id admits it, and an admitted one also needs a scoped credential_minting allowance naming it), "unavailable" (not reviewed, and Alter cannot read whether it is unreviewed right now: ask again later; policy_operation_id is null meanwhile) or null (no rule can name it: a request to it classifies as another operation, or its route is refused).

summary.description: One-line description, or null when the spec omits it.

provider_id.description: Resolved provider id the rows belong to.

provider_kind.description: Resolved provider family: oauth or managed.

spec_version.description: Alter's ingested spec version these rows came from.

total.description: Total operations matching the query (before limit/offset).
